card.name: Armistice and truce word endings
card.fires_on: The ending of the word armistice ("ice" after "armist") in historical text about World War I, and similarly the end of "truce". Weaker on words about agreed terms, such as ultimatum, talks, or condition.

modes.label: Armistice ending
modes.description: The last piece of "armistice" in text about the 1918 ceasefire between Germany and its enemies.

modes.description: Weaker cases at the end of truce, or in words about negotiated terms such as talks, ultimatum or condition.
